entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be connected.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie. I'm having an issue with my new VeloBand GPS Tracker. It's just not working correctly.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. To best assist, can you tell me specifically what is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?

It's a technical fault. The main reason I bought it, the pulse tracking, seems to be broken. The readings are erratic, and it won't sync that specific data to the app. I'm pretty sure the unit I received is defective.
I see, that certainly sounds frustrating when a key feature isn't performing as expected. Let me just pull up your account. Can I get your full name and order number?
Sure, it's Alex Reed, order number VF789012.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. You received it on January 1st, so about six days ago. I'm sorry you've had this trouble with it right away.

That's right. Since it seems to be a defective device, what are my options? I'm a long-time VeloFit user, and I'd like to get this resolved. A simple return would be fine, but maybe a partial credit towards a replacement could work too? I'm open to what makes sense.

Of course, I understand completely and we value your loyalty. Let me just check the official return policy for you... Okay, I see it here. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery, so you are well within that timeframe.
Oh, 90 days? That's great. So I can just send this one back for a full refund?

Absolutely. Given that the VeloBand is not working and appears to be defective, we can certainly process that for you. I've gone ahead and initiated the return. You'll receive a prepaid shipping label in your email shortly. And for the inconvenience, and as a thank you for being a VIP customer, I've also added a $25 credit to your account for any future purchase.
Wow, a full refund and a credit? That's more than fair. Thank you, Charlie, you've made this very easy. I appreciate the great service.
You're very welcome, Alex. We're happy to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
